evidence.reason: After edit calls reminders.evaluate(minutes, undefined, "benchmark") and no longer calls reminders.initialize(); the calendar string changed from "work" to "benchmark" and multiplier is explicitly undefined.
Default multiplier changed from configuration.rate to 0, so callers relying on the default (including evaluate when multiplier is undefined) now compute with multiplier 0.
assert.ok(await scheduledDelay(40) > 0) depends on the combined behavior of scheduledDelay and reminderDelay; with multiplier 0 and calendar "benchmark", the result may be non-positive.

assert.ok(evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0) still passes an explicit multiplier, but the changed default in reminderDelay affects other call paths and the removed initialize call may affect history state.

result.userExplanation: 这两处修改可能让 scheduledDelay 的返回值不再满足测试中大于 0 的断言，因为默认乘数被改为 0 且日历参数从 work 变成了 benchmark。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/reminders.ts 中 reminderDelay 的 multiplier 默认值，恢复为 configuration.rate（或让 evaluate 在 multiplier 为 undefined 时显式传入有效乘数），并确认 src/scheduling.ts 中 scheduledDelay 是否应继续调用 reminders.initialize() 以及 calendar 参数是否应为 "work"。
